board.name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision (Physician Assistant Advisory Committee)

totalAccepted.reason: Category I CME, as the app names it.

notes.text: Newly licensed PAs report no CME until one year after licensure.
A PA who has not met the hours by December 31 of the previous calendar year must obtain 40 Category I hours.

window.reason: The hours count over the calendar year before each March 31 renewal.

topics.label: Category I CME on substance abuse, each calendar year
Pain management, or opioid use or addiction, part of the annual hours

agreement.text: A practice agreement with each delegating physician is filed with the Medical Board within 10 business days of execution and of each change. A PA who has reported 6,240 or more postgraduate clinical hours may practice without one.

unverified: Whether one opioid addiction hour meets both the rule's substance abuse hour and the statute's pain management or opioid hour

options.text: At least 520 hours of nursing work in a position requiring the license, in the two years before expiry
At least 24 contact hours of continuing education applicable to nursing practice, in the two years before expiry
Current certification in a nursing specialty area
At least six academic semester credit hours of nursing coursework at your licensure level or higher

cycleYears.reason: The RN license renews every two years (the APRN renews with this two-year RN renewal).

ce.reason: APRN renewal requires current, maintained national certification; the hours below attach to prescriptive authority.

notes.text: The pharmacotherapeutics hours are not required when renewing within 24 months of initial prescriptive authority approval.

topics.label: Pharmacotherapeutics in the two years before renewal, for supervised prescriptive authority

condition.question: Do you hold supervised (not independent) prescriptive authority?
condition.description: Oklahoma pharmacotherapeutics hours for supervised prescriptive authority.

topics.label: Pain management, or opioid use or addiction, each renewal

condition.question: Do you hold a DEA registration?
condition.description: Oklahoma pain and opioid hours for DEA registered prescribers.

topics.label: Category I CME, 40 hours in the two years before renewal, for independent prescriptive authority (in place of the 15 pharmacotherapeutics hours)

condition.question: Do you hold independent prescriptive authority?
condition.description: Oklahoma APRNs with independent prescriptive authority renew it on 40 hours of Category I CME.

agreement.text: Prescriptive authority requires a supervising physician on file with the Board of Nursing, a signed supervising physician statement at renewal, and changes filed within 30 days. After 6,240 supervised prescribing hours an APRN may apply for independent prescriptive authority and no longer needs a supervising physician.
